heading: G-28 PDF Form Upload
page_text_first_1200: Jump to content An official website of the United States government Here's how you know My Account Resources Sign Out Skip to main content I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status Getting Started Client Information Upload PDF Upload Form I-485 Upload G-28 PDF Evidence Review & Submit G-28 PDF Form Upload Upload all pages of the Form G-28 in PDF file format only. Place all pages in the correct order by referring to the page numbers on the form. Include all pages when uploading, whether filled out with your information or left intentionally blank. You must: Upload one PDF file of the form; Include all pages of the form in the file, even if you did not provide any information on the page; and Arrange the form in the same order as its page numbers. If you choose to physically sign our PDF form prior to scanning, please ensure that the signature you provided on the PDF complies with USCIS regulations and policies. Namely, the signature must be handwritten, may not be typed, created by a typewriter, word processor, stamp, auto-pen, or similar device. You may also electronically sign your PDF form during the submission process. File upload requirements Clear and

_note: Page title 'USCIS | Upload PDF (G-28)'. Pure upload page, same shape as the I-765 /form-g28. On-page text says the signature must be HANDWRITTEN (not typed/stamped/auto-pen), so use the signed G-28 rather than the unsigned draft. It also mentions an alternative 'electronically sign your PDF form during the submission process' - that lives past /review and was NOT walked.
